Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the paternal grandfather of Edward de Vere, 17th Earl of Oxford, as John de Vere, 14th Earl of Oxford, rather than John de Vere, 15th Earl of Oxford. This error occurred because the Planner assumed that the grandfather would be two generations up from Edward without properly verifying the direct lineage from the provided sources. This mistake propagated through subsequent steps, leading to repeated searches for the wrong individual (the 14th Earl) instead of the correct individual (the 15th Earl), delaying the resolution of the real-world problem.
